recommendations.speaker: Niklas
recommendations.reasoning: Strong gross margins (~95%), LTV/CAC ratio of 6:1, technical moat with 24+ patents, strong enterprise customer base. Believes expansion strategy will lead to exponential profit growth.
recommendations.quote: Jag tror personligen på att de kommer att lyckas med expansionen framåt. Hur kraftig den blir och hur länge den kan pågå, det vet jag inte. Men jag tror att det är en klok satsning i alla fall.

summary: Market Makers discusses Norwegian video conferencing company Pexip, highlighting its strong competitive position in enterprise market with focus on security, on-premise solutions, and interoperability. Despite turning to loss due to aggressive expansion investment, hosts see significant potential given high gross margins, strong customer retention, and technical moat.
key_takeaways: Pexip serves enterprise customers requiring high security and on-premise hosting
Company has 24 patents, 95% gross margins, and 4,000+ customers globally
Pexip investing heavily in sales/marketing expansion, targeting 650 employees by 2022
LTV/CAC ratio of 6:1 suggests high profitability per customer acquisition
Niklas owns shares personally; hosts see potential but acknowledge volatility risk
